name: Art the Clown Halloween Costume Skits
what_it_is: Videos posted around Halloween 2026 in which creators dress as Art the Clown from the Terrifier films — white face paint, black-and-white harlequin costume, tiny top hat — and perform comedy skits, dances, and POV bits. Examples include a porch trick-or-treat skit, a dashcam-style night drive, a living-room character monologue, and group dances.
